name: reupmatic
description: Reupmatic desktop video processing and automation — integration build
author: canhta

scripts.build: npm run theme:build && npm run build:node && node scripts/generate-preload.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && vite build
scripts.test:core: npm run contracts:generate && npm run build:core && node --test 'tests/core/*.test.mjs'
scripts.test:bridge: npm run contracts:generate && npm run build:core && npm run build:node && node scripts/generate-preload.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local --test 'tests/native/*.test.mjs'
scripts.typecheck: npm run theme:build && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json --noEmit
scripts.test:python: npm run contracts:generate && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/python.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests/python -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test: npm run contracts:generate && npm run test:core && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:python
scripts.check:python: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check worker tests scripts && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check worker tests scripts
scripts.format:python: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check --fix worker tests scripts && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format worker tests scripts
